content: React 18/19 Strict Mode double-invokes mount/unmount/remount in dev only, to surface effects that aren't resilient to remounting. Refactors that move effects into custom hooks often expose previously-hidden double-fire bugs (double network calls, duplicated subscriptions) purely because the effect boundary moved -- not because behavior intentionally changed. Production is unaffected (fires once) so this manifests as a dev-only false alarm OR masks a real cleanup bug.
